sources.title: OPC UA ISA-95 Job Order
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 工廠數位分身驗證
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：重播結果不變，衝突可見，事件時間與接收時間分開且不丟更正歷史。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Replay is idempotent, conflicts are visible, times are distinct and correction history remains.
related.difference: 區分程式是否解對方程與模型是否代表實體，避免只看平均誤差為零。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish solving equations correctly from representing reality, and avoid relying on zero mean error alone.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 可重送訊息不等於可重複計數；以事件ID去重、以工件狀態機限制合法轉移，保存更正歷史。 合成100件唯一完工，97良品、3報廢；網路重送5筆良品事件，原始訊息共105筆。 去重良率97/100=97%；直接計訊息為102/105=97.1429%，且虛增5件。
殘差ri=預測−量測；bias=平均r，RMSE=√[平均(r²)]；零bias可由正負誤差抵消。 合成保留資料四個週期時間殘差[1,−1,2,−2] s，不使用它們調參。 bias=0 s，RMSE=√(10/4)=1.58114 s；平均零不代表逐筆正確。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Retryable messages are not repeatable counts; deduplicate by eventID, enforce part-state transitions and retain correction history. Synthetic 100 unique completions,97 good and 3 scrap; five good-event retries produce 105 raw messages. Deduplicated yield 97%; naive message counting gives 102/105=97.1429% and five fictitious parts.

Residualri=prediction−measurement; bias=meanr andRMSE=sqrt(mean(r_i²)); opposite errors can cancel bias. Four synthetic held-out cycle-time residuals[1,−1,2,−2] s, not used for tuning. Bias 0 s, RMSE 1.58114 s; zero mean does not imply accurate individual predictions.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: FANUC LR Mate 小型工業手臂
related.titleEn: FANUC LR Mate compact industrial arm
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：重播結果不變，衝突可見，事件時間與接收時間分開且不丟更正歷史。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Replay is idempotent, conflicts are visible, times are distinct and correction history remains.
related.difference: 分離重複性、視覺誤差與定位偏差，建立小件放置誤差預算。
related.differenceEn: Separate repeatability, vision error and bias in a small-part placement budget.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 可重送訊息不等於可重複計數；以事件ID去重、以工件狀態機限制合法轉移，保存更正歷史。 合成100件唯一完工，97良品、3報廢；網路重送5筆良品事件，原始訊息共105筆。 去重良率97/100=97%；直接計訊息為102/105=97.1429%，且虛增5件。
獨立零均值誤差可用平方和開根號；系統偏差需另列而不能隱藏在 RSS。；教學標準差為手臂 0.03 mm、視覺 0.04 mm；另有 0.12 mm 校準偏差。；σ=sqrt(0.03²+0.04²)=0.05 mm；偏差仍為 0.12 mm。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Retryable messages are not repeatable counts; deduplicate by eventID, enforce part-state transitions and retain correction history. Synthetic 100 unique completions,97 good and 3 scrap; five good-event retries produce 105 raw messages. Deduplicated yield 97%; naive message counting gives 102/105=97.1429% and five fictitious parts.

Independent zero-mean errors combine by RSS; systematic bias must remain separate.; Teaching standard deviations: robot 0.03 mm and vision 0.04 mm; calibration bias is separately 0.12 mm.; σ=sqrt(0.03²+0.04²)=0.05 mm; the bias remains 0.12 mm.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
